topic.title: AI Positron View
topic.shortdesc: Use the AI Positron view in a review task to get AI-generated suggestions and content while you work.

body.p: Click AI Positron in the left stripe to open the AI Positron view for the current review task.
body.note: The AI Positron view is only available for Content Fusion users with the Author platform user role.
body.p: For the AI Positron view to appear in the user interface, the Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion plugin must be installed and configured by an administrator.
The AI Positron view provides various ways to use AI-generated content or suggestions while editing or reviewing content.
For details about the available features and how to use them, see Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion User Manual.
